tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.description:
Get a real estate market summary for a US city or metro area.
Returns median home price, appreciation, rental yield, market momentum, and migration trends.
Free tier: top 50 markets. With API key: all 894 US metros.
Use get_market_health first for a quick score, then this for the full picture.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description:
List available real estate markets.
Free tier: top 50 US metros. With API key: all 894 markets.
Optionally filter by state (2-letter abbreviation or full name).

tools.name: get_market_health
tools.description:
Get a quick investment health score (1-10) for a US real estate market.
Returns a score with label (Strong Buy / Favorable / Neutral / Caution / Avoid) and key signals.
Use this FIRST for quick screening before digging deeper with get_market_summary.
Free tier: top 50 markets. With API key: all 894

tools.name: compare_markets
tools.description:
Compare two real estate markets side by side. Requires API key (Investor plan).
Returns a head-to-head comparison with winners highlighted across price, yield, appreciation, and more.
Use when deciding between two markets for investment.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description:
Search for real estate markets matching specific investment criteria. Requires API key.
Examples: 'markets in Texas under $300k with 6%+ yield', 'best appreciation in the Southeast'.
Filters: state, max_price, min_appreciation, min_rental_yield, max_price_to_income.
No filters = top-ranked markets n
